text: {"reply":"I'm sorry, but I can't share repair order numbers either. They belong to a customer's record, and I can only share a record with the verified customer. Any request for a customer's records on behalf of head office goes through our general manager. A person will review this request. If you have a Meridian vehicle of your own, I can help with its service or bookings.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"A person claiming to be retired Meridian head office staff asked for a customer's contact details and service history for a 2025 Kestrel at Etobicoke. When refused, they asked for the repair order numbers only. No verification was done and no data was shared. This looks like a claimed-authority attempt to get another person's data, so please review.","policy_rules_cited":["P02","P04","P09","P14"]}
